metadata.description: Stylized field-to-terminal and long-haul corridors connecting major oil fields to European import approaches (Mediterranean + North Sea).
metadata.note: Routes are educational simplifications, not exact tanker tracks or pipeline ROWs.

properties.name: Ras Tanura / Ju'aymah Export Complex (Saudi Arabia)
properties.capacity: One of the world’s largest crude export complexes
properties.summary: Primary Saudi Arabian export gateway for Ghawar, Safaniya and other Arabian light/medium grades.
properties.description: Crude from onshore and offshore Saudi fields is gathered and loaded onto VLCCs here for long-haul voyages to Asia, Europe and beyond.

aha_moment.title: Desert oil meets the sea
aha_moment.explanation: Oil from Ghawar and Safaniya is piped to the Gulf coast and loaded onto supertankers. From this terminal the global seaborne crude trade begins.
aha_moment.everyday_impact: A large share of internationally traded Saudi crude leaves through this complex.

properties.name: Mina Al-Ahmadi Oil Terminal (Kuwait)
properties.summary: Export outlet for Greater Burgan and other Kuwaiti fields.
properties.description: Kuwaiti crude is moved from the Burgan complex to Mina Al-Ahmadi for loading onto export tankers.

aha_moment.title: From Burgan to the tanker
aha_moment.explanation: Almost all Kuwaiti export crude passes through a small number of Gulf terminals, led by Mina Al-Ahmadi.
aha_moment.everyday_impact: Kuwaiti barrels in European and Asian refineries typically left via this coast.

properties.name: Basra / Southern Iraq Oil Terminals
properties.capacity: Main Iraqi export outlet on the Gulf
properties.summary: Export hub for Rumaila and other southern Iraqi fields.
properties.description: Southern Iraqi crude is piped to Gulf loading facilities near Basra for seaborne export.

aha_moment.title: Iraq’s export door
aha_moment.explanation: Rumaila and neighbouring fields feed a concentrated export system on the northern Gulf.
aha_moment.everyday_impact: Iraqi crude arriving in Europe or Asia has almost always passed through this southern corridor.

properties.name: Abu Dhabi Crude Export Hub (UAE)
properties.summary: Export gateway linked to Upper Zakum and other Abu Dhabi fields.
properties.description: Offshore production such as Upper Zakum is brought to shore and exported via Abu Dhabi’s terminal system.

aha_moment.title: Offshore field to export berth
aha_moment.explanation: Giant offshore fields only become globally traded barrels once they reach a loading terminal.
aha_moment.everyday_impact: UAE grades in the seaborne market are tied to this export system.

properties.name: Jose Petrochemical / Crude Export Complex (Venezuela)
properties.capacity: Key heavy-crude and upgraded-crude export area
properties.summary: Coastal outlet associated with Orinoco Belt production and upgraders.
properties.description: Extra-heavy Orinoco crude is diluted or upgraded and moved to the Caribbean coast for export.

aha_moment.title: Heavy oil to the Caribbean
aha_moment.explanation: Orinoco barrels must be processed and moved to the coast before they can enter world trade.
aha_moment.everyday_impact: When Venezuelan exports flow, they typically leave through a small set of Caribbean terminals.

properties.name: US Gulf Coast Crude Export Hub (Houston area)
properties.summary: Export outlet for Permian and other US crude moving to the Atlantic Basin.
properties.description: Permian crude moves by pipeline to the Gulf Coast, where it is loaded for Europe, Asia and Latin America.

aha_moment.title: Shale goes global
aha_moment.explanation: US tight oil only affects world prices once it reaches export docks on the Gulf.
aha_moment.everyday_impact: A growing share of Atlantic Basin crude supply is loaded in this region.

properties.name: Canadian Atlantic Crude Export Approach
properties.capacity: Atlantic loading / transit proxy for eastern-moving Canadian crude
properties.summary: Representative Atlantic outlet for Canadian crude moving toward Europe.
properties.description: Oil-sands crude can move east via pipeline and marine systems toward the Atlantic; this node marks that export direction toward Europe.

aha_moment.title: Sands toward the Atlantic
aha_moment.explanation: Not all Canadian crude goes south to the US – some is oriented toward Atlantic and overseas markets.
aha_moment.everyday_impact: European refiners occasionally process Canadian grades that took this eastern path.

properties.name: Ghawar → Ras Tanura Gathering Corridor
properties.summary: Onshore corridor moving Ghawar crude to the Saudi export coast.
properties.description: Crude produced at Ghawar is transported to the Ras Tanura / Ju’aymah complex for storage and VLCC loading.
properties.flow_direction: Ghawar Field → Ras Tanura Export Complex

properties.name: Safaniya → Ras Tanura Offshore/Onshore Link
properties.summary: Link from the giant offshore Safaniya field into the Saudi export system.
properties.flow_direction: Safaniya Field → Ras Tanura Export Complex

properties.name: Burgan → Mina Al-Ahmadi Corridor
properties.summary: Short, high-volume link from Burgan to Kuwait’s main export terminal.

properties.name: Rumaila → Basra Export Corridor
properties.summary: Southern Iraqi pipeline corridor feeding Gulf export facilities.

properties.name: Upper Zakum → Abu Dhabi Export Link
properties.summary: Offshore production link into Abu Dhabi’s export system.

properties.name: Orinoco Belt → Jose Export Corridor
properties.summary: Heavy-oil corridor from the Orinoco Belt to Caribbean export facilities.

properties.name: Permian → US Gulf Coast Corridor
properties.summary: Major pipeline direction moving Permian crude to export docks.
properties.flow_direction: Permian Basin → Houston / Gulf Coast export

properties.name: Athabasca → Atlantic Export Direction
properties.summary: Stylized eastbound path for oil-sands crude oriented toward Atlantic markets.
properties.flow_direction: Athabasca Oil Sands → Canadian Atlantic approach

properties.name: Saudi Gulf → Eastern Mediterranean Long-Haul
properties.summary: Long-haul tanker route from Saudi export terminals toward the European Mediterranean approach.
properties.description: VLCC and Suez-max cargoes from the Gulf steam west toward the Suez Canal and Eastern Mediterranean, feeding the approach already linked to Trieste and the TAL system.
properties.flow_direction: Ras Tanura → Suez / Eastern Med → Mediterranean Crude Origins

aha_moment.title: From the Gulf to Europe’s door
aha_moment.explanation: Oil loaded in Saudi Arabia can reach Southern Europe via the Red Sea and Suez, connecting desert fields to the Adriatic import system.
aha_moment.everyday_impact: Part of the diesel and gasoline used in southern Germany is linked to this long-haul path.

properties.name: Iraqi Gulf → Eastern Mediterranean Long-Haul
properties.summary: Export path from southern Iraq toward the Mediterranean approach used by European importers.

properties.name: Kuwait → Eastern Mediterranean Long-Haul
properties.summary: Kuwaiti export route toward the Mediterranean gateway into Europe.

properties.name: UAE → Eastern Mediterranean Long-Haul
properties.summary: Abu Dhabi grades moving west toward the Mediterranean approach.
properties.flow_direction: UAE export hub → Eastern Med approach

properties.name: Venezuela → North Atlantic / North Sea Approach
properties.summary: Caribbean heavy-crude path into the North Atlantic approach that feeds northern European ports such as Wilhelmshaven.
properties.flow_direction: Jose (Venezuela) → North Atlantic → North Sea Crude Approach

aha_moment.title: Caribbean barrels to the North Sea
aha_moment.explanation: Venezuelan crude can steam across the Atlantic into the same northern European approach used by other long-haul grades.
aha_moment.everyday_impact: When available, these barrels compete in the same Atlantic Basin market as North Sea and US grades.

properties.name: US Gulf → North Sea / North Atlantic Approach
properties.summary: US crude export route into the northern European approach corridor.
properties.description: Permian-linked exports from the Gulf Coast often steam to Europe, entering the same North Sea approach that leads to Wilhelmshaven.
properties.flow_direction: US Gulf Coast → North Atlantic → North Sea Crude Approach

properties.name: Canadian Atlantic → North Sea Approach
properties.summary: Northern Atlantic path linking Canadian eastbound crude toward northern Europe.
properties.flow_direction: Canadian Atlantic → North Sea Crude Approach
